notes.title: Version update (Demo)
notes.content:
Grandly launched the off-game growth system, enriching the gameplay and optimizing the experience
Reworked the event verification system
Added the game statistics interface
Modified the appearance logic of the cat assistant
Reworked the merchant function to provide multiple ways to obtain various items
Optimized some problems with skill dice in battle
Added several important reminder pop-ups
Replaced the mouse cursor style

notes.title: Version update
notes.content:
Redo the battle system to make the experience more interesting
Add more characters, and give them various personality traits, which will be activated under certain circumstances
Character attributes can be freely added
Add weapon feature settings, and weapons can be equipped with different skills
Add long-range attack weapons
Improve the atmosphere experience before entering the BOSS battle
Modify the NPC's speaking logic to make the process smoother
Adjust the functions of some cards such as "All-Seeing Eye"
You can use props to return to the place you have passed before for another investigation
Enrich the display contents of the archive interface
Add Steam achievement system (not available in the Demo version)
Add prompts for low HP and low SAN
Optimize the display of texts

notes.title: Version update
notes.content:
Fix bugs that get stuck during battles
Resolve the issue of blurry images in full screen mode
